PC: Utilized appropriate technique for BVM if needed
Utilized appropriate technique for intubation if required
Intervened appropriately for abnormal rhythm (Compressions, medications, defibrillation)
Established vascular access successfully if required
Participants will recognize apnea and prepare to intubate.
MK: Able to list causes of respiratory decompensation pre intubation
Able to list causes of respiratory decompensation post intubation

Participants will consider whether or not rapid sequence medications are needed and verbalize what medications might be used (choice may vary by institution, Fentanyl, Midazolam, with consideration of Atropine and a paralytic like Vecuronium would be our suggested choice).
SBP: Gave appropriate handoff for further care
ICS: Clear instructions given to team, closed loop
